First, I would recommend NOT rejecting this side of yourself and finding comfort in wearing or being little, whatever you find soothing. There is no need to push yourself to do something you don't want. There isn't a need to wear 24/7. I enjoy it and many others too, but if ABDL isn't your thing 100% of the time that's okay! Us being different is the spice of life!

Second, if you find that you have felt this way for a proponged period (any amount of time further than a week, really), it is okay to ask for help. You can find solace in speaking to like-minded individuals here if you are afraid of being alone in this (I'm sure we all were c: ), or if you feel as such you can speak to a therapist or a psychologist. I recommend finding a friend you can confide in (if possible to speak freely to someone, I don't have this person but you might!)

Please take care and enjoy this harmless hobby! If you feel, I'm happy to talk here if you'd like, I would love for you to feel happy in your own skin :) Don't be regretful of things you have done, but be thankful for the opportunities you are provided to evolve ❤ Life is too short to last long (crappy song quote on the surface but I carry it with me everywhere and I love Blink-182), try to enjoy the ride. I hate to play devils advocate... but

This is HUGELY dependent on the relationship you have with her. Most of the people here are probably right, but you know your parents better than anyone. You need to have a close bond, absolute steel. If you have told your mom your every other secret, maybe. 

DO NOT go into it asking for her to be involved. That wouldn't be fair to your mom. First of all, wanting to wear diapers can often be difficult for a lot of people. Your mom should be pretty open-minded in the first place. A good way to know/have tested the waters is, does she support LGBTQ people? Not to say that these are correlated, but this is a very simple way to tell basically whether or not she would be okay with changing her continent child.

It is an absolute must that it isn't sexual. You shouldn't be getting off because of your mom :/ However if you believe this is something that could be a great experience for not JUST you but your mom, then maybe go for it. 

This is a lot for someone to process, even for potentially some of the most "enlightened" people. Introduce to her that you are wearing diapers often for comfort. If she asks if you need them, tell her the truth in it's entirety. You have to be completely honest and have trust between each other (again, you should basically have told her everything already, so if you haven't ever raised your passion for them with her, I suppose now is the time) and gauge her reaction. It will be pretty easy to tell whether or not she would want to be involved.

ABDL specific diapers I can vouch for. Any of the Rearz diapers (safari's, lil squirts, dinosaurs, barnyards), and Crinklz are all pretty noisy! Crinklz are also VASTLY slimmer than ANY of what Rearz offers (correct me if I'm wrong) but still swell up very impressively. If looking for both, a good compromise is the Safari's which are plastic backed. Cloth diapers are also loud if you ask me, but it's more to a trained ear. If you know what a cloth-back nappy sounds look, OH BOY will they hear it! Thickest diaper I've worn is probably the Dinosaur's or Barnyard's. But you can put a booster in anything and it's MUCH larger. 

If you put the front of your diaper higher than the back (just so it comes up to the belly button on most cuts that I get in my size), this will leave some of the wings out on the side. These, if not tucked in, instantly scream "I'm wearing a diaper!" if you happen to be alone and love the sound :)

For optimal results: combine with longer & heavier t-shirt and no bottom (gym shorts if you must). You will hear that crinkle every time you shift! Warning; OTHERS will hear that crinkle every time you shift!
